test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'hardy'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• in the aforementioned sentence, **hardy **is an adjective that describes the plant.
 
• **Hardy **is the only **adjective **from given options that describes the ability of the plant to withhold tough weather conditions.

Hence the correct passage is: *The soya bean is called 'yellow pearl' by the Chinese. All the eight amino acids (1) that the body needs are present in it. It's a (2) rich and cheap source of protein. Even (3) unfavourable weather conditions can be withstood by this (4) hardy plant. Thus it is the key food that can (5) cater to India's future needs.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hard** and **Hardy **both are adjectives__.
 
• **Hardy: **strong and able to survive difficult conditions and bad weather (शक्तिशाली और कठिन हालात तथा ख़राब मौसम को झेल लेने वाला; सशक्त)
 
• **Hard:** not soft to touch; not easy to break or bend (कड़ा; जिसे तोड़ना या मोड़ना आसान न हो, कठोर, सख्‍़त)

 

46:T923,

The correct answer is '**cater**'
